name: NT tertiary fares reimbursement (interstate)
summary: Reimburses up to two return trips a year for NT students who move interstate to study a priority course not offered in the NT.
key: A maximum of 2 return trips per academic year may be reimbursed.
who: The applicant and student must be NT residents
Student moved from home in the NT to study full-time interstate
The course must not be available at Charles Darwin University or any other registered training authority within the NT
The course must be a priority field on the NT skilled occupation priority list
how: Complete the Tertiary fares reimbursement application form in GrantsNT by 30 September.
Claim with academic results, flight invoice and boarding pass.
catches: Apply by 30 September in the year you claim; submit the claim form by 31 March of the following year.
The cost of changing booked flights will not be reimbursed.
